message: I remember the time the power went out right in the middle of my favorite show! I’d just settled in with my popcorn, and suddenly—darkness. My phone was at 20%, and I realized I hadn’t charged my power bank. Feeling a bit frantic, I scrambled for my flashlight, only to find the batteries were dead, too. Lesson learned: I now keep my phone charged and have a backup power source ready, just in case. How do you stay connected when the lights go out?
